function.name: weather_forecast_get

message.content:
I don’t have access to real‑time clocks, so I can’t tell you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the precise time in New York City, you can:

* Check your phone or computer’s world‑clock feature.  
* Look up “current time in New York” in a search engine or on a time‑zone website.  
* Use a smart assistant (e.g., Siri, Google Assistant) and ask “What time is it in New York?”

Those will give you the exact local time, including whether it’s Eastern Standard Time (UTC‑5) or Eastern Daylight Time (UTC‑4).
